components.name: MentionComposer
components.description: A chat-style message box: type @ to mention a person and # to add a tag, Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line. Mentions come back as data in `onSubmit`, so they can notify people or link tags.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called on Enter or the send button. Shift+Enter adds a line break.

props.name: clearOnSubmit
props.description: Empty the composer after a submit.

props.name: leading
props.description: Before the text, e.g. an attach button.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Beside the send button, e.g. an emoji picker.

components.name: EditorShell
components.description: What SSR renders in an editor's place: the same frame, toolbar row and height.

components.name: EditorContent
components.description: The element ProseKit mounts into. ProseMirror adds its own classes to it, so keep `className` steady: a new value makes React overwrite them.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.setup:
const USERS: MentionUser[] = [
  { id: "1", name: "Ana Lopez" },
  { id: "2", name: "Ben Carter" },
  { id: "3", name: "Chloe Nguyen" },
  { id: "4", name: "Dev Patel" },
]
examples.code:
<MentionComposer
  users={USERS}
  placeholder="You can't post in this channel"
  disabled
  leading={
    <Button iconOnly size="sm" tone="ghost" aria-label="Attach file">
      <PaperclipIcon />
    </Button>
  }
/>
